title: Friend sees a black pyramid in Antarctica

tellings.quote: I have a friend who went down there and I think he was making a documentary or something and he saw this sort of black pyramid.

plain: A man who went to Antarctica, possibly to make a documentary, says he saw a kind of black pyramid there. Michels tells this himself, passing on what a friend of his told him. If true, it would hint at a structure hidden in the ice.
